pu॰ tisraH mAtrA uccAraRakAle'sya । plutasvare “ekamAtro Baved hrasvo dvimAtro dIrGa ucyate । trimAtrastu pluto jYeyo vyaYjanaM cArdDamAtrakam” SikzA॰ “praRavasya fzirbrahmA devo'gnistasya kaTyate । gAyatraYca BavecCando niyogaH sarvakarmasu । trimAtrastu prayoktavyaH prAramBe sarvakarmaRAm” saMvarttaH । Bojadevena tu tasya sArdDatrimAtrakatoktA yaTA “tajjapastadarTaBAvanam” pA॰ sU॰ “tasya sArdDatrimAtrikasya praRavasya japaH” vfttiH । yuktaYcEtat okArasya plutatvena trimAtratve'pi taduttaramakArasya vyaYjanatvAdardDamAtratvena sArdDatrimAtratvaM saMvartavacane trimAtrapadaM sArdDatrimAtre lAkzaRikamiti boDyam । vastutaH makArAntatve sArdDatrimAtratvam anusvarAntatve trimAtratvamiti BedaH । tadaBiprAyeREva tasya trimAtratayA japaPalaM praSlopanizadyuktaM tacca om SabdaM 1560 pf॰ darSitam ।

त्रि—मूर्धन् m. N. of a Rakṣas, Uttarar. ii, 15.

na॰ triguRitaM maDu saMjYAtvAt karmma॰ । “dugDaM sitA mAkzikaYca vijYeyaM maDuratrayam” ityukte 1 dugDAditraye । 2fgvedEkadeSe pu॰ 3 tadvrataBede tadAcaraRena 4 tadvedADyAyini pu॰ mitA॰ “maDuvAtA iti trayaH maDuSabdA yatra । maDuvAtA ityAdike 5fktraye pu॰ । “vedArTavit jyozWasAmA trimaDustrisuparRakaH” yAjYa॰ । “triRAciketastrimaDustrisuparRaH zaqaNgavit” manuH । 6 maDuSabdatraye ca “gAyatrI triH sakfdvApi japedvyAhftipUrvikAm । maDuvAtA iti tfcaM maDvityetat trikaM japet” iti pAraskaraH । 7 AjyapraDusitAtraye na॰ “kamalESca trimaDvaktErhunedazwottaraM Satam” tantra॰ ।
